items.stem: Why can an AI system still be unfair even though 'a computer' made the decision?

options.text: Because it learns from data that may contain human bias, which it can repeat or amplify
options.rationale: Correct: AI can inherit and scale bias present in its data.

options.text: Computers are never involved in unfairness
options.rationale: AI can be unfair when its data or design is biased.
Computers have no feelings; bias comes from data and design.

options.text: Because fairness is impossible to think about
options.rationale: Fairness can and should be reasoned about.

items.explanation: Correct: AI can inherit and scale bias present in its data.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO principles help make an AI system more trustworthy? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Transparency about how decisions are made
options.rationale: Correct: being able to explain decisions builds trust.

options.text: Clear accountability when something goes wrong
options.rationale: Correct: knowing who is responsible is essential.

options.text: Collecting as much personal data as possible with no consent
options.rationale: Excess data without consent harms privacy and trust.

options.text: Hiding the system's mistakes from users
options.rationale: Concealing errors reduces trust and accountability.

items.explanation: Correct: being able to explain decisions builds trust.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: A hospital uses AI to help prioritise patients and it makes a harmful error. Who should be accountable?

options.text: The people and organisation who chose, built and deployed the system remain responsible
options.rationale: Correct: humans and organisations stay accountable for AI they deploy.

options.text: No one, because the AI decided
options.rationale: Deploying an AI does not remove human accountability.
The affected people are harmed, not responsible.
Hardware is not a responsible party; the people who deploy it are.

items.explanation: Correct: humans and organisations stay accountable for AI they deploy.
